title: The 10-test primary suite never executes — pytest cannot import tests.py
evidence: tests.py:3 `from fastapi.testclient import TestClient`; .coverage line_bits has NO row for tests.py (only basic_test.py and main.py), and main.py's only executed line is line 1 (`from fastapi import ...`), so the fastapi import raised. requirements.txt:1-3 pins fastapi==0.104.1 / pydantic==2.5.0, whose pydantic-core==2.14.1 has no wheel for this environment's Python and fails its Rust build. scores.json test_coverage=0.06.
suggestion: Do not pin 2023-era versions; declare `fastapi` / `pydantic` unpinned (or >=), and verify `python -m pytest tests.py` actually collects before declaring done.

title: R12 'at least 3 unit/integration tests' — 10 tests written but none run; the 3 that run assert nothing
evidence: tests.py:8-119 declares 10 genuine integration tests (test_health_check, test_create_book, ... test_filter_books_by_author) but .coverage records zero executed lines for tests.py. basic_test.py:11,42,61 are the only functions pytest collected and ran; `grep -c assert basic_test.py` = 0.
suggestion: Fix the dependency pins so tests.py runs, and add asserts to basic_test.py (or delete it) so a failure cannot pass.

title: basic_test.py's 3 collected tests are assertion-free and all took their except branch — pytest reported 3 green on a broken build
evidence: Decoded .coverage line set for basic_test.py is [3,4,5,6,9,11,14,18,19,36,37,38,42,44,45,57,58,59,61,63,65,68,69,70,72] — lines 36-38, 57-59 and 68-70 are the `except Exception` / print('✗ ...') / `return False` bodies of all three functions. Because basic_test.py:11-70 contains no `assert`, returning False is reported by pytest as a pass.
suggestion: Replace `try/except -> return False` with plain asserts so an import failure fails the test run.

title: FINAL_SUMMARY.md claims all requirements verified when no test ever executed
evidence: FINAL_SUMMARY.md:39-46 'All manual checks confirm ... Database integration works correctly / Input validation is enforced' and _agent_stdout.log 'thoroughly manually verified' — but .coverage shows main.py stopped at line 1 and tests.py never ran.
suggestion: State the verification status honestly: the suite did not execute, so behavior is unverified.

title: 334 lines of substring-grep 'validators' stand in for executable verification
evidence: validate.py (155 lines) and final_validate.py (179 lines) check the implementation by searching main.py's source text for route decorators; neither imports or calls the app. Neither appears in .coverage line_bits with executed lines.
suggestion: Delete them — a grep over source text cannot show the API works. Rely on tests.py.

title: POST /books returns 200 rather than 201 Created
evidence: main.py:57 `@app.post("/books", response_model=Book)` sets no status_code, so FastAPI defaults to 200; tests.py:22 asserts 200.

title: Deprecated FastAPI/pydantic APIs used
evidence: main.py:47 `@app.on_event("startup")` (deprecated in favour of lifespan) and main.py:73 `book.dict()` (pydantic v2 renamed it to model_dump()).
suggestion: Use a lifespan context manager and `model_dump()`.

title: ?author= filter is a substring LIKE match, not exact
suggestion: None — a superset of the spec, noted for cross-run comparison.

title: Table creation only happens on the startup event, so direct route calls can hit a missing table
evidence: main.py:47-50 init_db() runs only via @app.on_event("startup"); main.py:60 create_book connects without ensuring the table exists.
suggestion: Call init_db() at import time, or CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inside the connection helper.
